авария.en: As a result of the car crash two people were killed and one was injured.

авария.en: In a single day five hundred and four people were injured in car accidents in Russia .

август.en: My grandmother's birthday is on the 5th of August.

австралиец.en: Her father was an Australian and her mother was an American.
